notes.title: Update Notes - 26/04/2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43867565/b4bef42057e7f871eef7e049c52e4df2ce03bde3.png[/img]

First of all, we would like to express our endless gratitude to all gamers who have reviewed and supported our game's development.

We are happy to take confident steps forward with you gamers towards being more successful in this and future projects, developing with your ideas.

Let's jump on the updates we have made.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43867565/d522af6f8c10da1e891b2af895a1b57b0d762a63.png[/img]

Polished Materials

We noticed that some of the materials looked a bit dull after the previous update, so we put effort into polishing them to create a better visual appearance. Together with the lighting adjustments we introduced in the previous update, we believe that we have achieved a much nicer visual experience now.
We hope you like it.

Change (again) "How to Play" screen.

We took into account the feedback from players that this screen was not simple and explanatory enough, and opted for a simpler design. We think you will like it.


Keep supporting us and don't hesitate to share your feedback. Have fun and enjoy the game!

Best Regards.

Plusumbrella Gaming & Software
Website: http://plusumbrella.com/
Mail: pressplusumbrella@gmail.com

notes.title: Patch Notes for 15/04/2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43867565/987836452a4c05e0ceed912588e97cdb02d6aa3e.png[/img]

Taking into account the reviews and tests that came after the release of the game, we decided to prepare an update.
We have fixed some known bugs and introduced new mechanics for a smoother gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43867565/2d731b728a21ae151f14c8c605a5fa2dbca0225b.png[/img]

[b]Crouch Mechanic[/b]

We had obstacles in the game that required players to crouch to pass under them, which was done by pressing a button. This mechanic reduced the fun of the game and did not look visually appealing. We have added a new feature using VR mechanics. Now, you can bend down and pass under obstacles yourself. Just duck under it.

[b]Hand Positions[/b]

The positions of the controllers did not match the in-game hand positions. We adjusted the hand positions, and they now have a more comfortable and realistic feeling.

[b]Haptic Feedback[/b]

We have added the Haptic Feedback feature to the controllers in order to enhance the feeling of using the pickaxes in the game. We hope you will enjoy it.

[b]Steam VR Support[/b]

You can now play our game through Steam VR.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43867565/d522af6f8c10da1e891b2af895a1b57b0d762a63.png[/img]

[b]UI and Pointer[/b]

Some UI's wasn't clickable cause of pointer and UI position issues. We have stabilized the pointer location in the game and made UI elements more clickable by positioning them correctly.

[b]Ingame Lights[/b]

The lighting in some levels was insufficient, causing players to have trouble seeing their way forward. We apologize for this issue. We have adjusted the in-game lighting and the illuminated miner's helmet worn by the character to make the environment more visible.

[b]How to Play[/b]

We realized that the in-game "How to Play" instructions were not clear enough. We have updated them to include two guides that we hope will be more helpful.

[b]Sound Effects[/b]

We have added a few new sound effects to the game that will enhance its realism. They are not many, but they are noticeable.

Thank you for downloading our latest update! Have fun playing and stay tuned for more.

Best regards,
+Umbrella Team
